title: Step-up password confirmation
summary: Local public accounts must confirm their password again before changing it on the profile page. Confirmation expires after a short window so older elevation does not stay open.
changes: Add a confirm-password screen and routes that re-check the local account password before sensitive profile password changes.
Require recent password confirmation on the signed-in local password-change action, with a short timeout that re-prompts when it expires.
Regenerate the session after a successful confirmation so privilege elevation uses a fresh session id.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.39.x Account security line: step-up password confirmation after the auth email brand kit (0.39.0).
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Passkey-based confirmation is not included yet; later Account security work will extend the same step-up gate.
Username, email, authenticator, and passkey change flows will adopt this gate as those waves land.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Profile password change returns to current-password validation only, without the separate confirm-password step. No database migrations are included in this release.
